verses.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
verses.sm: Nepukanesa Ua lua tausaga o le nofoaiga a Nepukanesa, ona fai ai lea o miti a Nepukanesa, ua atuatuvale ai lona finagalo, ua le iloa e ia sina moe.

verses.en: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu e aami i tauláitu, ma vaafaatau, ma e fai togafiti faataulaitu, atoa ma le au Kaletaia, e faailoa mai i le tupu ana miti; ona latou o mai ai lea ma tutu i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te i latou, Ua fai la‘u miti, ua atuatuvale ai lo'u loto i le fia iloa le miti.

verses.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai ai lea o le au Kaletaia i le tupu i le upu Arama, Le tupu e, ia soifua oe e faavavau. la e fetalaia mai le faalepo i au auauna, ona matou faaali atu ai lea o le uiga.

verses.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu le tupu, ua faapea atui le au Kaletaia, Ua mavae atu ia te au le mea; afai tou te le faailoa mai ia te au le miti ma lona uiga, o le a vaevaeniniina outou, e fai foi o outou fale ma faatáfuna.

verses.en: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.sm: A e afai tou te faailoa mai le miti ma lona uiga, tou te maua mai ia te au o mea alofa, ma le taui, atoa ma le mamalu tele; o lenei, ia outou faailoa mai ia te au le miti ma lona uiga.

verses.en: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
verses.sm: Ua toe tali mai i latou, ua faapea mai, Ina fetalai mai ia le tupu i ana auauna le faalepo, ona matou faailoa atu ai lea o lona uiga.

verses.en: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu le tupu, ua faapea atu, Ua ou iloa lava tou te faatuatuai, aua ua outou iloa ua mavae atu ia te au le mea.

verses.en: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
verses.sm: A e afai tou te le faailoa mai ja te au le miti, e tasi lava le tulafono ia te outou; auá ua outou saunia upu pepelo ma le faaʻoleʻole e fai mai ia te au, seia faatuatuai; o lenei, ina outou taʻu mai ia ia te au le miti, ona ou iloa ai lea ua outou mafaia ona faailoa mai ia te au lona uiga.

verses.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king's matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o le au Kaletaia i le tupu, ua faapea mai, E leai se tagata i le lalolagi na te mafaia ona faailoa mai le mea a le tupu; o le mea lea e leai ai se tupu, po o se alii, po o se faipule ua ia fetalaia mai se mea faapena i se taulāitu, po o se vaafaatau, po o se Kaletaia.

verses.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.sm: O le mea foi ua fetalai mai ai le tupu, E faigata; e leai lava se tasi na te mafaia ona faailoa atu i le tupu, na o atua lava, latou te le mau faatasi ma tagata.

verses.en: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.sm: O le mea lava lea na ita ai, ma matua lili ai le tupu, ua fai atu foi ia faaumatia le au popoto uma o i Papelonia.

verses.en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
verses.sm: Ona oo atu ai lea o le poloaiga ia fasiotia le au popoto; ona latou saili ai lea ia Tanielu ma ana uo ia fasiotia.

verses.en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Tanielu ma le faautauta ma le poto ia Arioka le pule i le ʻau e faafeao i le tupu, o le na alu atu e fasioti i le au popoto o i Papelonia;

verses.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.sm: ua tautala atu ia, ua faapea atu ia Arioka, le ua i ai le pule mai le tupu, Pe se a le mea ua tele vave ai le poloaiga a le tupu? Ona faailoa lea o le mea e Arioka ia Tanielu.

verses.en: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
verses.sm: Ona ulufale atu ai lea o Tanielu, ma faatoga atu i le tupu, seʻi faatuatuai, ona faailoa ai lea o le uiga i le tupu.

verses.en: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o Tanielu i lona fale, ma na faailoa atu le mea ia Hanania, ma Mesaelu, ma Asaria, o ana uo,

verses.en: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.sm: ina ia latou faatoga atu ia alofa mai le Atua o le lagi i lenei mea ua lilo, ia le faaumatia Tanielu ma ana uo faatasi ma le au popoto uma o i Papelonia.

verses.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.sm: Ona faaali mai ai lea i le faaaliga i le po ia Tanielu o le mea sa lilo; ona faamanú ai lea o Tanieiu i le Atua o le lagi.

verses.en: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Tanielu, ua faapea atu, Ia viia le suafa o le Atua e faavavau, e faavavau lava; auā e ona le poto ma le mana.

verses.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verses.sm: O ia foi na te liua tausaga ma tau; e aveeseina e la o tupu, e tofia foi e ia o tupu; e foaiina mai e ia le poto i e o popoto, ma le malamalama i e o iloa mafaufau.

verses.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
verses.sm: O ia na te faaalia mai mea loloto ma mea ua lilo; ua na silafia le mea o loo i le pouliuli, o le malamalama foi la te mau faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king's matter.
verses.sm: Ou te faamanú ma vivii atu ia te oe, le Atua o oku tama, o le ua foaiina mai ia te au le poro ma le malosi; ua e faailoaina mai nei foi ia te au le mea sa matou aioi atu ai ia te oe; aua ua e faailoa mai ia te i matou le mea a le tupu.

verses.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
verses.sm: Ona ulufale atu ai lea o Tanielu ia Arioka, le na tofia e le tupu e faaumatia le au popoto o i Papelonia; ua alu atu ia ma faapea atu ia te ia, Aua le faaumatia le au popoto o i Papelonia; ta o ma oe i luma o le tupu, ona ou faailoa ai lea o le uiga i le tupu.

verses.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
verses.sm: Ona faataalise lea ona ulu atu o Arioka ma Tanielu i luma o le tupu, ua na faapea atu ja te ia, Ua ou maua le tagata o le tafeaga o luta na te faailoa atu le uiga i le tupu.

verses.en: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tupu, ua faapea mai ia Tanielu o le ua igoa ia Peletisara, Oa e mafain ea ona faailoa mai ia te au le miti na a‘u iloa, atoa ma lona uiga?

verses.en: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Tanielu i luma o le tupu, ua faapea atu, E le mafai i e popoto, ma vaafaatau, ma tauláitu, ma e o popoto i fetu, ona faaali atu i le tupu o le mea a le tupu ua lilc na ia fetalai atu ai.

verses.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
verses.sm: A o iai le Atua i le lagi, o le na te faaalia mea ua lilo, ma faailoa mai ia Nepukanesa le tupu o mea e oo mai i aso arnuli. Sa faapea lau faalepo ma le mea na e silafia i lou tofaga.

verses.en: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.
verses.sm: O oe, le tupu e, sa tutupu ou manatu i luga o lou tofaga i mea e 00 mai i aso amuli. O le na te faaali mai mea ua lilo ua ia faailoa mai ia te oe o mea o le a oo mai.

verses.en: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
verses.sm: O afu foi, e lei faaalia mai ia te au lenei mea sa lilo ona o se poto ua ia te au e sili i tagata ola uma, na o lenei, ona ia faailoa i le tupu le uiga, ma ia e silafia manatunatu o lou finagalo.

verses.en: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.
verses.sm: O oe, le tupu e, na e silafia, faauta foi o le tasi tupua tele; o lenei tupua tele sa maeu lona matagofie, na tu i ou luma, sa matautia foi lona tino mai.

verses.en: This image's head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
verses.sm: O le ulu o lenei tupua, o le auro lelei lea; o lona fatafata ma ona lima, O le ario ia; o lona manava ma ona ogavae o le “apa memea ia.

verses.en: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
verses.sm: O ona vae, o uamea ja, o ona tapuvae O uamea isi mea, a o omea isi mea.

verses.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
verses.sm: Na e silasila ua tofia le maa a e lei tofia i lima, na lavea ai le tupua i ona tapuvae na fai i uamea ma omea, ua nutililii ai ia mea.

verses.en: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
verses.sm: Ona nutililii faatasiina ai lea o le uamea, o le omea, o le “apa memea, o le ario, atoa ma le auro, ua pei o le aputi i le mea e soli ai saito, ua lelea i le matagi, ua le maua lava se mea latou te i ai; a o le maa na lavea ai le tupua ua avea lea ma mauga tele, ua tumu ai le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
verses.sm: O le faalepo lena, o le a matou ta'uina atu foi i le tupu lona uiga.

verses.en: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
verses.sm: Le tupu e, o oe o le tupu o tupu; auā ua foaiina mai ia te oe e le Atua o le lagi le malo, ma le malosi, ma le mamalu, ma le viiga;

verses.en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.
verses.sm: ua na avatu foi ia te oe mea uma e mau ai tagata, ma manu o le vao, ma manu felelei, ua tuuina atu ia mea uma i lau pule; o le ulu auro o oe lava lea.

verses.en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
verses.sm: A mavae atu oe, ona tu lea o le tasi malo, e le tusa ma oe; ma le tasi o lona tolu foi o malo, o le “apa memea lea, e pule foi lea i le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
verses.sm: O lona fa foi o malo e malosi ia pei o le uamea; aua e nutililii ma tu“imomomo mea uma i le uamea, e pei o le uamea ona tufimomomo o la mea uma e faapea lea malo ona nutililii ma tu‘imomomo.

verses.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
verses.sm: E vaevaeina foi le malo, aua na e silafia tapuvae ma tamatamai vae o uamea isi mea, a o isi mea o omea a le fai ipu omea; a E peitai e i ai lava ia te ia le malosi o le uamea, aua na e silafia le uamea ua filogia ma le omea a le fai ipu.

verses.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
verses.sm: O tamatamai vae foi o uamea isi mea a o omea isi mea, e faapea lava le malo, e malosi nisi mea a e vaivai nisi mea.

verses.en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
verses.sm: Na e silafia le uamea ua fefiloi ma le omea a le fai ipu, e faapea foi ona filogia o i latou ma le fanau a tagata; a e latou te le pipii le tasi i le tasi, e pei ona le filogia foi o le uamea ma le omea.

verses.en: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
verses.sm: O ona po o ia tupu e faatuina ai e le Atua o le lagi o le malo e le faaumatia e faavavau; o lea malo foi, e le tuuina atu ia i se tasi nuu, na te tufimomomoina ma faaumatia ia malo uma lava, a o ia e tumau lava e faavavau;

verses.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
verses.sm: E pei ona e silafia na tofia le maa i le mauga, a e lei tofia i lima, ma na tu'imomomoina le uamea, le “apa memea, le omea, le ario, atoa ma le auro. O mea ia ua faailoa mai ai e le Atua silisili i le tupu o mea e oo mai amuli; e moni lava le ia, e faamaoni foi lona uiga.

verses.en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
verses.sm: Ona faapaú fao ai lea o Nepukanesa le tupu, ua ifo ia Tanielu, ua ia fai atu latou te avatu la te la se taulaga atoa ma mea manogi.

verses.en: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia Tanielu, ua faapea atu, E moni, o lo outou Atua o le Atua O atua ia, ma le AW o tupu, o lé faaali foi i mea ua lilo, auá ua e mafaia ona faaali o lenei mea sa lilo.

verses.en: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.sm: Ona avatu ai lea e le tupu o le mamalu tele ia Tanielu, ua na foai atu foi ia te ia mea alofa e tele ma le sili, na ia tofia foi o ia e pule ile itu malo uma o Papelonia, ia sili foi o ia i e pule i le au popoto uma O Papelonia.

verses.en: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
verses.sm: Ua faatoga atu Tanielu i le tupu, ona ia tofia lea o Sataraka, o Mesako, ma Apeteniko latou te pule i sauniga a le itu malo o Papelonia; a o Tanielu, sa nofo o ia i le faitotoa o le tupu.
